subject: MerchantBridge MAP: AWS private-offer close playbook
messages:
From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@merchantbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MerchantBridge MAP: AWS private-offer close playbook

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to map a concrete path to purchase for MerchantBridge: we want an AWS private offer (reserved private SKU) and a clear billing/PO path so our finance team can cut an invoice.

High level ask: can you send a Mutual Action Plan that covers evaluation checkpoints, technical acceptance criteria, expected sign-off owners, and estimated billing milestones (invoice vs marketplace private-offer flow)? Our procurement team is on a tight April–May window and needs the PO path documented to scope approvals. I attached a short Statement of Work (draft) for context.

Procurement lead: procurement@merchantbridge.com
Technical lead: leah.ortiz@merchantbridge.com

Ideal timeline we shared internally:
- 4/12: final security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence
- 4/19: technical acceptance fully validated
- 4/26: PO issued / private-offer signed
- 5/03: billing live / invoice clearance

Can the Redwood team confirm a target MAP and any gating items we should expect?

Thanks,
Leah Ortiz
Head of Platform Engineering | MerchantBridge
Attachment: MerchantBridge_SOW.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@merchantbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantBridge MAP: AWS private-offer close playbook

Leah —

Appreciate the clear timeline. Draft MAP below (high-level) and I’ve called out owners and artifacts we’ll need. We can convert to a one-pager or shared Google Doc after you confirm.

Redwood MAP (MerchantBridge) — Target close: 4/26
1) Security & legal (owner: Priya) — due 4/12
   - Deliverables: SOC2 summary, data-flow diagram, contract redlines (if any)
   - Notes: Priya will provide the SOC2 excerpt and our privacy addendum; expect a short review turn of 48 hours.
2) Technical acceptance (owner: Karthik) — due 4/19
   - Deliverables: acceptance checklist, smoke test results on private-offer instance, latency/cost snapshot for typical workload (3 sample prompts)
   - Gate: successful inference runs with agreed latency SLO and no data leakage artifacts
3) Commercial & procurement (owner: Naomi / Priya) — due 4/26
   - Deliverables: finalized private-offer contract, PO instructions (marketplace flow vs invoice), invoice timeline
   - Billing path options: (A) AWS Private Offer + AWS invoice via MerchantBridge finance (typical) OR (B) Redwood issues invoice after marketplace acceptance (slower; only if required)
4) Go-live billing cutover — target 5/03

Quick next steps I suggest:
- Priya: share SOC2 excerpt + PO template (we can use Redwood PO template attached) — by EOD 4/11
- Karthik: schedule a 60 min tech-acceptance session w/ MerchantBridge devs by 4/12
- Naomi: prepare private-offer draft and target signature template — by 4/16

If that aligns, I’ll produce a short MAP doc and a mutual-action checklist we can track in HubSpot (I’ll add the link).

Thanks — look forward to closing quickly.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@merchantbridge.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantBridge MAP: AWS private-offer close playbook

Naomi / Leah —

Thanks — I’ll own technical acceptance. Quick checklist I’ll run with your team during the session:
- Provision private-offer instance in us-west-2 (same vCPU / GPU spec as demo)
- Run three representative workloads (batch + chat + embeddings) and capture 95th pct latency and cost-per-1k tokens
- Confirm KV-cache persistence works across restarts for session workloads
- Validate model-variant fallback (our policy) and confirm no silent degradation
- Verify encryption-at-rest (KMS) and network egress rules for private deployment

I propose the acceptance session on Mon 4/12 10:00–11:00 PT. Leah — does that work for your infra/devs? I’ll post a short acceptance doc to the shared Drive after the session.

Also flagging one potential gating item: if MerchantBridge needs a custom quantization profile for lower-cost inference we should scope that early (adds ~3 business days).

-Karthik
Senior Infra Eng, Redwood Inference
From: Leah Ortiz <leah.ortiz@merchantbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@merchantbridge.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 07:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantBridge MAP: AWS private-offer close playbook

Karthik / Naomi —

Mon 4/12 10:00 PT works for the infra team. I’ve looped in procurement for the PO path and they asked for two things today:
1) A PO template Redwood accepts (we can issue PO to Redwood or via AWS vendor flow).
2) Short note on invoice timing / when MerchantBridge will be billed (immediately after private-offer activation vs monthly invoice).

We also confirm we won’t need a custom quantization profile at launch — we’ll accept the default quant that matches demo numbers to keep scope narrow.

I’ll have procurement send the formal PO contact later today.

Thanks,
Leah
Attachment: (none)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MerchantBridge MAP: AWS private-offer close playbook

Looping in Redwood billing — I’m attaching our PO template and the two PO paths we accept. Naomi, I’ll send the HubSpot MAP doc + acceptance checklist link after the tech session.

Attachments: redwood-private-offer-PO-template.docx (docx)

- Priya
Head of Commercial Ops, Redwood Inference
